title: Optimization Supervisor (Workforce)
description:
About One Call

One Call is a leading healthcare solutions provider specializing in the coordination of care for injured workers within the Workers' Compensation industry. With more than 30 years of experience, One Call partners with insurance carriers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and self-insured employers to simplify the claims process and improve outcomes for injured workers.

Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, One Call delivers end-to-end healthcare coordination through an innovative, technology-enabled platform and a nationwide network of providers. Our mission is to ensure injured workers receive timely, high-quality care while delivering exceptional service to our clients and partners.

Position Summary

The Supervisor - Workforce Optimization is responsible for leading a team of Workforce Management agents focused on real-time performance monitoring (SLA, ASA, abandon rate, occupancy, and shrinkage), staff optimization (scheduling, VTO, extra hours, and shrinkage management), and implementing timely action plans to mitigate performance deviations.

This role collaborates closely with WFM and Operations Leadership to provide data-driven insights, drive operational efficiency, and build a high-performing team aligned with One Call's core vision and values.

Key Responsibilities

Collaboration & Operational Strategy (40%)

  • Provide insights on operational performance to WFM collaborators and the Operations Leadership team.
  • Leverage data, results, knowledge, and trends to present impacts on performance along with actionable recommendations.
  • Plan, organize, and control resources for optimal utilization to achieve performance targets.
  • Effectively navigate ambiguity and drive alignment between company vision, mission, and values when making operational decisions.
  • Incorporate diverse perspectives by collaborating with peers, colleagues, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a backup to senior leadership in their absence when needed.

Cultivate Talent & Team Leadership (40%)

  • Lead, coach, and manage a team of Workforce Management agents, aligning their goals with departmental objectives.
  • Play an integral role in hiring, onboarding, and professional development activities.
  • Identify skill, tool, and talent gaps, implementing target action plans to address deficiencies.
  • Conduct regular 1:1 coaching sessions to provide performance feedback and development plans.
  • Administer corrective action when necessary to address policy or performance issues.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and fun work environment while celebrating team successes.

Administrative & Real-Time Management (20%)

  • Monitor volume to ensure inbound and outbound calls route properly.
  • Monitor real-time, daily, and monthly reports for adherence to scheduling and service level parameters.
  • Recommend and execute timely adjustments to optimize coverage and achieve SLA targets.
  • Ensure skill profiles are assigned to representatives in a timely manner throughout the day to optimize call routing.

Qualifications

Required

  • Associate's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in call center workforce management or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in a leadership or supervisory role.
  • Minimum of 3 years utilizing Workforce Optimization applications (e.g., Aspect, eWFM, NICE, or Verint).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and relevant software.

Preferred

  • Experience with contact center reporting and advanced operational metrics.
  • Genesys Cloud

Skills & Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical skills to critically assess situations and make real-time decisions.
  • Detail-Oriented & Problem Solving: Excellent decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
  • Leadership & Coaching: Proven ability to mentor, manage performance, and develop talent.
  • Communication: Excellent oral and written communication skills to interact effectively with staff and business partners.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, navigate ambiguity, and manage moderate to significant mental stress.
  • Core Values Alignment: Demonstrates alignment with company values: Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together, and Care Deeply.

Work Environment

  • Remote / Work-from-Home position (requires a dedicated home office setup with reliable equipment).
  • Occasional in-person team meetings may be required.
  • Dynamic, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Law benefits.
  • Food vouchers.
  • Monday–Friday schedule.
  • Professional growth and career development opportunities.
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment.

Schedule

  • Monday to Friday
  • 9:00 am to 6:00 pm (The operations window is from 6 AM to 6 PM, and the schedule may be subject to change)

Location

title: Horticulture Energy Specialist
description:
We are seeking a collaborative, solutions-focused Horticulture Energy Specialist to join our Energy Trust of Oregon team serving the agriculture and manufacturing sectors in Oregon.

This is both a technical and relationship-heavy field position that will promote Energy Trust of Oregon’s energy efficiency offerings to indoor grow (typically cannabis) customers, contractors, vendors, distributors, and community organizations. This multidisciplinary role combines local outreach and project management to help customers identify and complete energy-saving projects.

Key Details:

  • Location: Portland, OR and surrounding areas. Relocation assistance is provided. Our office is in SE Portland and working from home is OK after onboarding period.
  • Travel: Travel to contractor and customer sites and to support outreach at events in the Portland metro area and Willamette Valley; approximately 25%-40% of the time.
  • Pay: Full base pay range is $75,000 - $115,000 commensurate with skills and experience. Our target hiring range is at or below mid-point to allow for growth and internal equity. All positions are eligible for an annual bonus and profit share on top of base pay.
  • Benefits: Health, dental, vision, disability, FSA or HSA option, 401K with 4% match and profit sharing, annual cash performance bonus, paid vacation, paid sick time, paid floating holidays, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, home office stipend, and first-time homebuyers assistance.
  • Schedule: Full time; 40 hours per week; Monday-Friday

About Energy 350: The future is bright at Energy 350! We are an energy efficiency consulting firm located in Portland, OR. Energy 350 is a leader in energy efficiency programs, policy, research, evaluation, and engineering. At Energy 350, we care about our employees and prioritize a balanced work lifestyle. We look for fast learners who are highly motivated and mission driven to join us in our casual yet hard working environment where we value people for who they are and for their differences.

To learn more, out our website:

Position Overview: The Irrigation Energy Engineer is a technical outreach and account management role focused on helping indoor grow vendors, contractors, and customers move energy efficiency opportunities from initial lead to completed project. This person will serve as a trusted field resource, building relationships across Energy Trust of Oregon’s territory while developing expertise in efficient indoor agricultural systems (especially grow lighting and dehumidifiers). The role is well suited for a self-starter who enjoys learning technical details, solving practical problems, and collaborating with a wide range of people in the field and internal teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Collaborate with contractors, customers, and internal teams to identify and assess energy efficiency projects at cannabis and other indoor agriculture customer sites.
  • Manage project pipelines, including schedules, follow-up actions, savings estimates, incentives, and documentation deadlines.
  • Conduct regular calls, field visits, joint customer meetings, presentations, trainings, and attend industry events.
  • Proactively engage contractors and vendors to increase awareness of Energy Trust’s Industry & Agriculture energy efficiency incentive offerings
  • Identify and overcome customer and vendor barriers to participation.
  • Collaborate with distributors to promote energy efficient products to contractors, vendors, and Energy Trust Trade Allies.
  • Maintain accurate, timely records in Salesforce and use Microsoft-based tools for collaboration with internal teams and regular reporting.
  • Work closely with outreach, customer account managers, engineering, project processing team, marketing, and other program partners to provide a seamless customer and contractor experience.
  • Qualifications: We are looking for a technical, solutions-focused team player who is energized by engaging the community to help cannabis customers and contractors participate in energy efficiency incentive offerings.

Ideal candidates will have some of the following skills and experience:

  • Engineering degree or technical degree strongly preferred
  • Experience in indoor horticulture/cannabis industry
  • Experience with energy efficiency programs; working knowledge of technical energy efficiency concepts in lighting and dehumidifying
  • Experience with the local horticulture, indoor ag, and/or cannabis contactor network, technical services, and/or contractor account management
  • Working knowledge of grow lighting and dehumidifier systems
  • Excellent computer skills, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
  • An energetic self-starter with excellent organizational, scheduling, and planning skills
  • An organized, proactive, and solutions-focused approach to account management
  • An outgoing person who is excited to make new connections; adaptable to dynamic settings
  • Capability of working autonomously with good project & time management skills
  • Excellent writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills

Energy 350 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

We provide a competitive salary, exceptional benefits, room for growth, and an amazing work environment surrounded by excellent people.

title: Analytics Engineer, SFR Real Estate
description:
Evergreen Residential is a high growth Real Estate Company and institutional investment platform in the single-family residential ('SFR') and build-to-rent (“BTR”) sectors. We are committed to changing the way investors own and manage SFR homes, and to building a modern way to deliver the data, tools and services that enable our clients to invest in the world’s largest asset class at scale. Our team is collaborative, open-minded and curious. Transparency is a core value, we speak our minds, are responsible for our actions and celebrate our wins. We are serious about our business, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

We offer a flexible, empowering culture, competitive compensation and benefits, and the opportunity to work with and learn from industry pioneers and experts.

If you are self-motivated and mission driven with a ‘can do’ mindset and see solutions where others may see problems, come and grow with us!

We are committed to changing the way investors own and manage SFR homes, and to building a modern way to deliver the data, tools and services that enable our clients to invest in the world’s largest asset class at scale. This is a highly cross-functional role: you will work directly with the business to understand its logic and needs, build data models in our analytics warehouse, and use those models to create dashboards and answer business questions. While the work spans teams, data models are your primary work product. Initial focus is modeling data from our property management system and purchased external market data to create one source of truth for reporting and analysis. For Post- This is a full-time employee role based in our Dallas office (4 days in office, 1 day remote). The Company is unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Resumes will only be considered if the additional information questions are answered.

The Role: The role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Partnering with business stakeholders to understand business logic, drivers and needs, and translating them into consistent, well-defined metrics
  • Developing and maintaining data models that transform data from our property management system and external market data sources into a clean, centralized analytics warehouse in Snowflake
  • Writing tests and documentation to ensure data accuracy and reliability
  • Building dashboards and analyses on top of those models to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Participating in code review and contributing to the standards and conventions of our dbt project
  • Being a resource for improving data proficiency throughout the organization
  • Staying up to date with emerging trends and technologies in analytics engineering

What You Will Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field preferred, or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, business intelligence or a related field, including at least 1 year building dbt models in production
  • Experience working in an AI-first development environment (e.g., using AI coding assistants and agents to write, test and review code)
  • Strong SQL skills and a solid background in data modeling (dimensional modeling preferred) and analytics engineering best practices
  • Experience with dbt and Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse and at least one BI/dashboarding tool; experience with Tableau and/or Python a plus
  • Experience working in Git with pull request-based development workflows
  • Experience in real estate investment and/or rental sector desirable, including familiarity with property management system data
  • A proven problem solver, comfortable turning ambiguous business questions into clear data models, with a sound understanding of technical tradeoffs
  • Collaborative team player, you are truly a “do-er”, happy to be a hands-on problem-solver to move the data program forward
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written

title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
Join a team where your impact reaches beyond the stars! At Terran Orbital, you’re not just part of the system – you’re a vital force propelling our mission forward. As trailblazers in satellite manufacturing and aerospace innovation, we shatter boundaries daily to deliver groundbreaking solutions that power our nation’s defense and commercial missions. We are a unique, fast growing, and trusted team dedicated to swiftly and efficiently designing, building, launching, and operating state of the art satellites for advanced mission constellations. If you’re driven by purpose, inspired by challenges, and ready to leave your mark on the universe, you’ll find a home and endless opportunities for growth here. Together, let’s redefine what is possible in orbit and beyond!

Terran Orbital is seeking an experienced Flight Software Engineer to join our growing and fast‑paced spacecraft development team. Reporting to the Flight Software Engineering Manager, you will design, develop, test, and maintain the mission‑critical software that controls our satellites and ensures successful spacecraft operations in orbit.

You will contribute across the full spacecraft software lifecycle—from requirements definition and architecture through on‑orbit commissioning and operations. This role offers the opportunity to work hands‑on with real spacecraft hardware, simulation environments, and a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain flight software modules responsible for guidance, navigation, control, payload operations, power management, communication, autonomy, and fault protection.
  • Develop software for diverse mission payloads, including imaging systems, advanced sensors, and propulsion‑based maneuvers such as aero‑braking and lunar descent profiles.
  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and regression tests using existing frameworks to ensure robust, reliable, and verifiable flight code.
  • Integrate and validate software across multiple environments, including high‑fidelity simulators, hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) testbeds, engineering development units (EDUs), and flight‑like spacecraft hardware.
  • Collaborate with systems engineering, GNC, avionics, payload, and ground software teams to define software requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
  • Participate in on‑orbit commissioning and support early operations of newly launched satellites, assisting in debugging, telemetry analysis, and software tuning.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, including CI/CD pipelines, coding standards, and documentation.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience developing C++ applications for embedded, real‑time, or safety‑critical systems (Level II).
  • Strong understanding of embedded software concepts such as memory management, concurrency, and real‑time constraints.
  • Highly motivated, self‑directed, and able to operate effectively in a fast‑moving team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • U.S. Citizenship with eligibility to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Additional Differentiators

  • Hands-on experience using A.R.M. and Texas Instruments embedded processors and associated development environments.
  • Proficiency with Linux development workflows and GNU toolchains (Make, GCC, GDB, etc.).
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automation and tooling.
  • Experience within the aerospace industry, particularly in satellite or space‑mission software development.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined case-by-case and may vary based on the job-related qualification, knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer 100% covered medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) match, Flexible Time Off (FTO), covered life insurance, maternity and paternity leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referrals, and lots of swag!

Salary Range
$125,000—$150,000 USD

Full-time positions only:

Benefits

  • 100% Company-paid comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
  • 401(k) Match
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Education Reimbursement
  • Competitive Paid Parental Leave

About Terran Orbital

Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite products primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries. Terran Orbital provides end-to-end satellite solutions by combining satellite design, production, launch planning, mission operations, and on-orbit support to meet the needs of the most demanding military, civil, and commercial customers. Learn more at www.terranorbital.com

Physical Demands

An employee must meet the physical demands described to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. In performing the duties of this job, the employee is routinely required to sit or stand for long durations of time, in addition to bending, reaching, and walking. This would require the ability to lift or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move objects up to 25 pounds. This position is generally sedentary, with substantial computer usage.

Work Environment

The job operates in a professional office environment but in a manufacturing company. This job routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and scanners.

In addition, please note that this position may require a current United States National Security clearance or eligibility for such a clearance.

title: Backend Software Engineer, Odoo
description:
At Exness, we are not just a leading trading broker—we’ve reimagined what it takes to be a leader. With 40M+ trades a day and 2,000+ people across 13 countries, we combine scale, care, and real tech to make trading better for 1M+ clients worldwide.

Recognised globally as a Best Place to Work, we’re a people-first company where long-term wins always matter more. As part of our team, you will shape the future of fintech with real technology, care, and purpose.

Why this role matters

As a Backend Software Engineer, Odoo within the Enterprise Applications team, you will play a key role in evolving and maintaining a world-class ERP system built on the Odoo platform. Your work will directly support mission-critical business functions across the company by designing, customising, and integrating ERP solutions that are secure, scalable, and well-aligned with the needs of internal stakeholders. You will be responsible for full-cycle development: from technical design and implementation to data migration, deployment, and user support. Additionally, you will ensure seamless interoperability between Odoo and other internal systems such as HRM, FP&A, and DWH platforms, enabling efficient data flows and streamlined business processes.

The role is based in our Limassol office, Cyprus. In case of relocation, we offer full relocation support for you and your family to make your move smooth and worry-free.

What you'll actually do

  • The Odoo Developer is accountable for the continuous evolution, maintenance, and technical integrity of the company’s Odoo-based ERP platform. This includes driving code quality, performance improvements, database design, and ensuring long-term scalability of the system architecture.
  • Architectural review of solutions, development of plans for designing and evolving the system.
  • Responsible for configuring and adapting the ERP system to support critical business workflows across departments. This includes user access setup, workflows, scheduled jobs, and participation in environment management across development, staging, and production.
  • Own the design, implementation, and maintenance of custom Odoo modules and extensions, including externally-facing systems such as the vendor portal. Ensure these components are robust, secure, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Accountable for integrating Odoo with other enterprise systems — such as HRM, FP&A tools, and data warehouses — to enable automated, reliable, and scalable data exchange. This includes developing and maintaining RESTful APIs and handling data synchronisation.
  • Provide day-to-day technical support for ERP users by investigating and resolving issues related to system functionality, customisations, and integrations. Act as the first responder for functional troubleshooting and user enablement.

Who we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with the Odoo platform, including development of custom modules, system configuration, and integration.
  • Proven track record in ERP implementation and support, ideally within product or tech-driven companies operating at scale.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, ORM frameworks, and designing scalable data models.
  • Exposure to cross-system integration projects, especially in domains such as finance, HR, or procurement, is considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including experience with Odoo’s ORM, business logic, and server-side architecture.
  • Deep understanding of the Odoo framework, including module inheritance, views, access rights, scheduled actions, and workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, performance tuning, and complex queries.
  • Practical experience with odoo.sh, including managing branches, deploying environments, reviewing logs, and handling automated testing and staging flows.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development and integration, enabling seamless communication between Odoo and external platforms (e.g., HR, finance, DWH).
  • Proficiency in Git-based workflows and collaborative development tools (e.g., GitHub, GitLab).
  • Familiarity with data migration, upgrade management, and scripting tools for import/export between legacy systems and Odoo.
  • Ability to write and maintain unit, integration, and functional tests, ensuring stable, regression-free delivery of ERP features.

Nice to have:

  • Odoo-specific certifications, such as:
    • Odoo Functional Certification
    • Odoo Technical Certification
  • Additional relevant certifications:
    • PostgreSQL or database design certifications
    • Python programming certifications (e.g. PCEP, PCAP)
    • ERP implementation or business process modelling credentials

  • Full relocation support for you and your family — flights, housing, visas, and legal assistance included
  • Top-tier health insurance with full family coverage — medical, dental, vision, mental health — plus life insurance for peace of mind

Summary

The Festival Area Manager is responsible for the business performance, audience engagement, content strategy, and successful execution of assigned festival areas across DreamHack festivals.

What you will do

Reporting to the Director, Festival Management & Delivery, you will own the performance and growth of assigned festival areas across the DreamHack festival portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Area ownership and business performance

  • Own the performance and long-term development of assigned festival areas, including ensuring participation through outreach to communities and external stakeholders (i.e reaching out to Artists in Artis Alley, Indie game developers, TCG vendors, Cosplayers, local tournament organizers etc)

Content and activity development

  • Act as the primary stakeholder owner for communities associated with assigned areas

Marketing collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to ensure assigned areas receive appropriate visibility before and during festivals
  • Contribute content plans, key messages, promotional opportunities, and audience insights
  • Support campaign development by ensuring assigned areas are accurately represented across marketing channels

On-site area leadership

  • Lead the execution of assigned festival areas during event build-up and live operations
  • Recruit, brief, and onboard area staff, volunteers, contractors, contributors, and day-to-day activities
  • Ensure content, activities, partner commitments, and attendee experiences are delivered according to plan
  • Act as the primary point of contact for issues and decision-making within assigned areas during the event
  • Maintain quality standards and ensure a positive experience for attendees, partners, and contributors

Reporting and continuous improvement

  • Measure and report on area performance including attendance, participation, engagement, NPS, revenue contribution, and partner value
  • Conduct post-event reviews and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Document learnings, recommendations, and best practices to improve future festivals
  • Support the development of long-term growth plans for assigned areas

Requirements

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in live events, gaming, esports, entertainment, experiential marketing, community management, audience development, partnerships, or related industries
  • Experience owning and growing programs, business units, communities, content portfolios, or customer-facing initiatives
  • Experience working cross-functionally with multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience managing budgets and evaluating business performance

Skills

  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen
  • Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills
  • Experience developing content, communities, programs, or audience-facing initiatives
  • Strong communication and presentation abilities
  • Data-driven decision making and performance analysis
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

Personal Attributes

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Passionate about creating exceptional attendee experiences
  • Community-focused and audience-centric
  • Commercially minded and results-driven
  • Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments

Success in This Role

Success in this role means:

  • Assigned festival areas achieve strong attendance and engagement
  • Attendees report high satisfaction and positive experiences
  • Areas generate meaningful commercial value and sponsor opportunities
  • Communities continue to grow and strengthen year-over-year
  • Content remains relevant, innovative, and differentiated
  • Assigned areas contribute positively to DreamHack's overall business performance

What this role is not

The Festival Area Manager is not a Product Manager, Project Manager, or Production Manager.

Unlike the former Product Manager role, the Festival Area Manager does not own the end-to-end lifecycle, planning, or delivery of festival products.

The Festival Area Coordinator does not:

  • Lead project management or production planning processes
  • Own operational delivery, readiness, or festival-wide execution
  • Manage procurement administration
  • Create or manage project plans, sprint boards, or operational workflows
  • Coordinate infrastructure requests, logistics, venue requirements, internet, power, or fabrication needs
  • Act as the primary liaison between Festival Production and Operations
  • Manage festival floorplans, or cross-functional production dependencies
  • Own administrative planning tasks such as catering requests, logistics trackers, or procurement workflows
  • Own budget for their designated area (the Director, Festival Management & Delivery owns this)

These responsibilities are owned by the Director, Festival Management & Delivery.

Instead, the Festival Area Coordinator focuses on defining what makes their assigned areas successful and ensuring they deliver strong audience value, community engagement, commercial opportunities, and business results.

The ideal candidate for this role is a business-minded content, community, or audience development leader rather than a project manager, producer, or operations specialist.

FLIP is the leading refurbished consumer electronics platform in Southeast Europe, operating across Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Greece. As part of the eMAG ecosystem, we are building the most trusted marketplace for pre-owned devices, and growing fast. We run a data-driven, performance-obsessed commercial operation, and we are looking for someone who loves turning complexity into clear decisions.

The Commercial Data Scientist acts actually as A Decision Intelligence operator. Are we taking the right decisions based on our strategy and objectives? Is the planning reflecting reality? What are the Risks & Opportunities and how can we tap them? Your role will build and consolidate models & frameworks that recommend the best way forward to hitting our targets and creating clarity for strategic choices & their trade-offs.

This is a high-exposure role. You will present to senior leadership, challenge assumptions with data, and engage directly with Commercial/Growth, Marketing, Supply, Finance, Operations, and Product & Tech to turn insight into action. You will also co-create the engine behind FLIP’s forecasting capability: building the process, challenging the inputs and co-owning the accuracy.

What you’ll have to do:

What this role is really about

The core of the job is triangulation: reconciling several independent angles on the same number until you can defend it and explain what moved it. We expect you to triangulate three sets of drivers:

  • GMV: what is driving growth, or holding it back.
  • Profitability: the quality of that growth, not just its size.
  • Forecast accuracy: how much confidence we can put behind the plan.

Triangulate means you never take a single number at face value. You cross-check top-down against bottom-up, model against actuals, volume against price, and you can always say which driver moved and by how much (by having a clear view of correlation and causality between drivers).

Responsibilities

  • Generate insights on elasticity, customer behavior and market dynamics per market, using fair like-for-like comparisons.
  • Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation and AI usage, including automated reporting against budget and current forecast.
  • Build models and frameworks that make trade-offs explicit: price versus volume, category mix versus margin, promotional cost versus incremental units.
  • Act as a trusted analytical partner to growth, marketing, supply, finance, and product leadership, and navigate competing priorities across them.

What makes you a good fit:

  • Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling and machine learning.

  • A/B testing and experimental design experience with measurable business impact.
  • Daily use of AI tools in your workflow. FLIP runs Claude Enterprise across the company; we expect you to build with it, not around it.
  • A proactive, self-starting mindset with end-to-end ownership of your domain.
  • Strong stakeholder management: you can hold your ground in a commercial debate and explain what a model implies for the P&L to senior leadership, in plain language.

What you can expect:

description:

You will work hands-on with a modern stack (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Git/GitHub) and with AI coding agents in your daily engineering work. You will also have the autonomy to take requests from intake to production, propose what we should build next, and shape safe team practices for agentic development. If you want a role where your judgment directly determines whether the business can trust its data, this is it.

Impact in this Role

The Senior Data Engineer is the go-to owner of MISUMI’s Snowflake warehouse, dbt project, and data pipelines. This person turns data from business and production systems into trusted, analytics-ready models that Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Customer Support use to make decisions. Because this is the primary data engineering role, the accuracy, security, and reliability of the data platform, including regulated data such as CUI, depend on this person’s judgment and execution.

Essential Functions

  • Administer Snowflake: manage users, roles, grants, warehouses, resource monitors and security policies, and keep the environment secure, fast and cost-efficient.
  • Design, build, and own dbt models (staging, intermediate, marts, and the semantic layer) that turn replicated source data into trusted, analytics-ready tables with tests and documentation.
  • Build, operate, and monitor ELT pipelines from production and business systems into Snowflake, using Fivetran and related tools. Resolve connector failures, schema changes, backfills, and data-quality issues.
  • Act as the team’s primary technical resource for modeling and pipeline work. Take requests from intake to production independently, including scoping, estimating, and reporting status.
  • Translate business requirements into technical requirements and data models, and bridge the gap between business teams and technology. Ask clarifying questions, agree on metric definitions and acceptance criteria with stakeholders, and turn them into specifications the team can build and test.
  • Proactively identify opportunities where data, modeling, or automation can help the business get closer to its goals, and propose and prioritize them with stakeholders instead of waiting for requests.
  • Run an impact analysis before changing, deprecating, or removing any shared table, model, or connector. Use dbt lineage, Snowflake dependency and access metadata, and stakeholder review, and document a rollback plan.
  • Own the Git and GitHub workflow for the dbt project: branching standards, pull-request review, automated tests, and deployment.
  • Use AI assistants and agentic workflows in daily engineering work to speed up SQL and dbt development, testing, documentation, code review, and debugging, and help set safe team practices for using them.
  • Find the root cause of data-quality, performance, and pipeline problems and fix them at the source.
  • Tune queries, models, and warehouse usage, and advise engineers and analysts on efficient query patterns and table design.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, data-flow diagrams, and schema documentation.
  • Lead data design sessions and technical reviews, and explain design trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Evaluate new Snowflake and dbt features and tools, and recommend improvements to the data platform.
  • Mentor analysts and engineers on SQL and dbt best practices.
  • Work with remote, cross-functional teams across time zones.
  • Maintain and contribute to the Quality Management System (QMS).

Desired Traits

Five core skills. Candidates must show direct, hands-on production experience in each:

  • Snowflake administration and engineering: access control, warehouse sizing and cost control, query tuning, clustering, security controls, cloning, time travel, and data sharing.
  • dbt expert modeling: layered models, dimensional modeling, incremental models, snapshots, macros, tests, documentation, and CI/CD through Git.
  • Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, recursive queries, semi-structured data, and query tuning.
  • ETL/ELT tooling: Fivetran (our tool) or similar, including connector setup, schema drift, deleted records, backfills, and cost.
  • Agentic coding and development: daily use of AI coding agents that work in the repository and terminal (not chat-only use), with disciplined verification of everything they produce.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of experience as a data engineer, designing, building, and operating data pipelines and warehouses.
  • 6+ years of hands-on Snowflake experience in production, including administration: access control, warehouse management, and cost and performance monitoring.
  • 5+ years building and maintaining production dbt projects (dbt Core or dbt Cloud), including testing, documentation, incremental models, macros, and CI/CD.
  • 5+ years working with ETL/ELT tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, Matillion, Informatica, or Talend, plus experience with pipeline orchestration.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using agentic coding tools that work directly in the codebase (not chat-only AI use) in daily data engineering work. This includes building agentic workflows or tool integrations for data work, such as MCP servers, custom agents, or automated dbt and pipeline checks, with concrete examples of the workflows and results.
  • Expert SQL, including CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Daily use of Git and GitHub pull-request workflows.
  • Experience being the primary or sole owner of a data platform, or the technical lead for one.
  • Experience administering data platforms that hold regulated data (such as CUI under NIST SP 800-171), including access control, audit logging, encryption, and data classification. Must be able to pass a background check and complete required CUI and security training.

Preferred

  • Direct Fivetran experience, including connector management.
  • Experience with Sigma Computing, or with Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI tool.
  • Experience modeling ERP and CRM data, such as NetSuite or Salesforce.
  • Python for data tooling and automation.
  • Snowflake SnowPro certification or dbt certification.
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience for Snowflake, such as Terraform.
  • Background in manufacturing, supply chain, or marketplace businesses.

Abilities

  • Write advanced SQL on large, complex datasets, including semi-structured data such as JSON in Snowflake VARIANT columns.
  • Apply data warehousing and dimensional modeling principles to turn business requirements into well-structured, maintainable models.
  • Work independently: take an open-ended problem, define the approach, deliver it, and raise risks early instead of stalling.
  • Use sound production judgment: verify before changing shared systems, plan for failure, and know how to roll back.
  • Use AI tools with discipline: give clear context and constraints, review and test every AI-generated change, and stay accountable for the result.
  • Solve hard problems methodically: break an unclear problem into testable hypotheses, gather evidence from logs, lineage, and query history, confirm the cause before changing anything, and verify the fix worked.
  • Communicate clearly in writing and in person, giving business context to engineers and technical context to non-engineers.

Physical Demands

The employee routinely sits, talks, hears, and uses hands and fingers to operate a keyboard. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Travel

Ability to travel 5% annually in the US for team meetings, offsites, and conferences.

Ready to own the platform?

If you have run production Snowflake, dbt, and ELT at scale, you work daily with agentic coding tools, and you want to be the person the business trusts with its data, we would like to hear from you. Apply today.

Salary range:

$167,000 - $202,300 base salary per year, depending on experience

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Generous PTO and leave programs

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

These people, businesses, and accounts are foundational components of the Alpaca system, and we need to build new capabilities while achieving very high automation rates. We are expanding the platform to handle identity verification on a global basis and to support our growing set of account types.

We are looking for senior engineers who are keen on providing quality solutions, have great fundamentals, have proven experience building and architecting at scale, and are not afraid of challenging conventions or voicing their opinions. In this role, you will have the autonomy to design and implement solutions to achieve defined goals while actively participating in defining those goals.
